Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock - Microraptors
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[size=5][b]Increase your animal diversity by adding Microraptors to your coop![/b][/size]

After donating a petrified elongated finger bone of unknown origin, Gunther presented you with a small blue egg. When Marnie caught wind of your find she reached out to an old penpal at DewGen ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41588]again[/url]), a somewhat shady genetics research organization. You don't know how they did it, but they brought Microraptors back to life. Who knows, maybe there's a way to unlock more varieties!

[b]Huge shoutout to [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HarrisonGrey]HarrisonGrey[/url] for their help figuring out how to toggle unlock conditions and special conditions! [/b]
 
[b][size=4][u]Features[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Adds Microraptor dinosaurs as a new animal to Marnie's shop! This is not a reskin of the dinosaur. 
[*]Microraptors will produce eggs every day that can be converted into mayonnaise (2 eggs : 1 mayo), pickled (4 eggs : 1 pickled eggs), opalized in the crystalarium (yes, you heard that right!), sold, given to grateful villagers, or hatched using an incubator in the coop to hatch a Microraptor chick! 
[*]Chicks will hatch after 5 in game days, and mature into adults after 5 days
[*]Mod comes in 2 play styles, available in the configurations menu of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿﻿﻿: Unlock Required and No Unlock
[/list][size=3][u]Unlock Required (recommended)[/u][/size]
[spoiler]The intended way to play, elongated finger bone artifacts (new item) will drop from all kinds of geode at a rate of 10%. Once found, donate it to Gunther to receive a Microraptor egg as a reward. The next day Marnie will send you a letter informing you microraptors are now available in her shop. [/spoiler]

[size=3][u]No Unlock[/u][/size]
[spoiler] If you're not feeling the tediousness of finding their finger bones in the wild, de-select the UnlockCondition setting in the config menu. Donation and rewards from the museum still possible! You will still need to unlock the special skins, by either placing a microraptor egg in the crystalarium and donating the resulting opalized microraptor egg, or spawning one using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]Item Spawner[/url]. [/spoiler]

[u][b][size=4]Installation Notes[/size][/b][/u]
I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23721]Extra Museum Space[/url]﻿ so you don't run out of room with the new mineral, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] to add Microraptors to Marnie's shop smoothly and select specific skins. [u]NOTE:[/u] MISSING THE SPECIAL SKINS AT FIRST IS NOT A BUG. YOU MUST DONATE AN ITEM TO UNLOCK THEM. See spoilers above if you need clarification. 

﻿﻿This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ to work correctly! 
Download and install the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher
Download and unzip "[CP] BBs New Livestock-Microraptors" ver 1.0
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

Note on Skins- If you do not have Livestock Bazaar, though I highly recommend it, you will have to set the skin that appears in Marnie's shop manually using Generic Mod Config Menu﻿, and choosing a default. If you do not have either Livestock Bazar or GMCM, you can still get different Microraptor skins, however it will be dependant on RNG and you must still unlock them, as the non-common skins have a lower probability of hatching from eggs (1/2 as likely).

[size=3][u]Patch Notes[/u][/size]
None for now!

[size=3][u]Future Update Wishlist[/u][/size]
None for now, open to suggestions! 

If you have any requests or suggestions please leave a comment or shoot me a message! :>
